observation.interpretation: The profile hypothesis is supported for this sample: disabling stack trace detail removes most observed wall-time overhead.
observation.semantic_risk: jree JavaObject uses Error.stack to infer a translated class FQN; stackTraceLimit=0 may prevent that registration and is therefore not an approved production change.
observation.decision: Do not change runtime behavior yet. First identify a project-owned compatibility seam or an equivalent lazy class-name cache, then run M1/M2 regression and representative marker checks.

limitations: The control wall time is a direct formal CLI run while the marker time is from the recorded runner baseline; this is not a repeated statistical benchmark.
Only one small NAL sample was tested.
No code or node_modules file was modified by this experiment.
